title: SetsView.tab shadows the session's EmojiPanel.tab (Installed/Trending/Search) and is kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the emoji packs box, type a query (panel.tab=Search, view.tab=Installed), clear the field: the view tab decides which tab to go back to; select_emoji_sets_tab and show_emoji_sets_tab each write one of the two
effect: No wrong output today; a path that sets one tab without the other would show the highlighted tab and the list out of step
fix: One tab value in the panel with a separate Search { return_to } variant

title: event_log_ids (Cell<Vec<i64>>) mirrors the ListState item count and must be reset together with it
trigger: Any path that calls event_log_list.reset/splice without writing event_log_ids (or the reverse) leaves the plan_sync diff against rows that are not in the list
effect: List rows out of step with the entries (wrong or missing rows) until the next reset
fix: Keep the shown ids inside one owner that wraps the ListState and only changes through sync()

title: Reopening Share Folder while a link delete is still out asks for the list without waiting for the delete, so the deleted link comes back
trigger: In Share Folder press Delete on a link and confirm (LinkOp::Saving(request)), Done/close the box at once (close_folder_share hands the request to closed_asks as LinkChange), reopen Share Folder: open_folder_share -> driver.fetch_folder_share(folder_id), which (connect/folder_links.rs fetch_folder_share) only checks links.is_loading(), not a DeleteChatFolderInviteLink in flight; getChatFolderInviteLinks can be read before the delete lands. refetch_outdated_folder_links only runs when links.is_outdated() (a list that was loading when the delete was sent), and settle_closed_folder_asks LinkChange arm does nothing on success
effect: The deleted invite link is listed again (with copy/edit) until the box is reopened after the delete has landed; deleting it again errors
fix: fetch_folder_share waits for (or is re-sent on the answer of) the in-flight DeleteChatFolderInviteLink of that folder; the LinkChange ask refetches the list on success

title: A second addlist link opened while an add is out is dropped: the old box is shown and the new link is never checked
trigger: Add a shared folder (InviteStage::Adding), click another t.me/addlist link before the answer
effect: Box for the first folder re-raised; the second link silently ignored (comment says it waits, nothing remembers it)
fix: Keep the next link in the Adding stage (Adding { request, info, next }) and check it when the add settles, or say it was ignored

title: EventLogPage.poll Option<Task> is a started/stopped flag: a poll that ended because the page closed or the view changed leaves Some(finished task)
trigger: Recent Actions open (poll Some), go back in the Group Settings dialog (event_log_open_chat() None): event_log_poll_tick returns false and the task ends but page.poll stays Some; resume_event_log_poll only restarts when poll.is_none()
effect: Only the window-inactive path clears poll, so resume after wake cannot tell a dead task from a live one; re-entering the page relies on start_event_log_poll being called from group_admin_settings (open path) every time
fix: enum PollStage { Stopped, Running(Task<()>) } set to Stopped by the loop's own exit through the page
